QuestionText: An operations team wants to run the same AWS resource-listing command from a terminal in an automated script. Which access method fits?
Explanation: AWS CLI omogućava upravljanje AWS servisima komandama i zato odgovara ponovljivim skriptama.

QuestionText: A mobile application written in Java needs to call AWS APIs using language-specific libraries. What should its developers use?
Explanation: AWS SDK sadrži biblioteke za programski pristup AWS servisima iz podržanog jezika.

QuestionText: A new administrator needs to inspect and create a few AWS resources through a web browser without writing code. Which interface is most direct?
Explanation: Management Console je web interfejs za ručno upravljanje AWS resursima.

QuestionText: A company keeps some systems in its own data center and moves others to AWS. What deployment model does this describe?
Explanation: Hibridni model kombinuje lokalnu infrastrukturu sa resursima u AWS Cloudu.

QuestionText: A web tier must keep serving users if one Availability Zone becomes unavailable. Which deployment choice best supports this goal?
Options: Place all instances in one subnet in one AZ
Copy the AMI to another account only
Place instances in two or more AZs behind a load balancer
Explanation: AZ-ovi su odvojene lokacije; raspodjela instanci i saobraćaja kroz više AZ-ova povećava dostupnost.

QuestionText: A company must keep customer data within a particular country where AWS has an eligible Region. What is the primary infrastructure choice?
Options: Choose that AWS Region for the workload
Choose an Amazon S3 object prefix
Explanation: AWS Region je geografsko područje za smještaj resursa i podataka; izbor Regije podržava zahtjeve rezidentnosti.

QuestionText: Which TWO statements distinguish AWS edge locations from Availability Zones? (Choose 2.)
Options: Edge locations are identical to AWS Regions
Edge locations help deliver content nearer to viewers
Availability Zones are only billing constructs
Every edge location contains a full VPC
Availability Zones host regional resources such as EC2 instances
Explanation: CloudFront koristi edge lokacije za isporuku sadržaja; AZ-ovi su izolovane lokacije unutar Regije koje hostuju regionalne resurse.

QuestionText: A scientific batch job spends most of its time performing CPU-intensive calculations. Which EC2 instance family category is the best starting point?
Explanation: Compute-optimized instancama je naglasak na CPU kapacitetu za računski intenzivne zadatke.

QuestionText: An in-memory database needs a large amount of RAM relative to CPU. Which EC2 instance category is most appropriate?
Explanation: Memory-optimized instance pružaju visok odnos memorije prema procesoru za radne terete u memoriji.

QuestionText: A data-processing application needs very high sequential read and write throughput on local disks. Which EC2 category should be considered?
Explanation: Storage-optimized instance su namijenjene radnim teretima s visokim protokom i pristupom lokalnom skladištu.

QuestionText: A machine-learning team needs GPUs to train a model on an EC2 instance. Which instance category is relevant?
Explanation: Accelerated-computing instance mogu koristiti GPU i druge akceleratore za ML i slične zadatke.

QuestionText: A team wants AWS-native orchestration for Docker containers, but it does not require Kubernetes APIs. Which service is the direct fit?
Explanation: Amazon ECS je AWS-ov upravljani servis za orkestraciju kontejnera; EKS je namijenjen Kubernetesu.

QuestionText: Which TWO statements about AWS Fargate are correct? (Choose 2.)
Options: It runs containers without customers managing EC2 hosts
It can be used with Amazon ECS or Amazon EKS
It requires purchasing EC2 Reserved Instances first
Explanation: Fargate je serverless kapacitet za kontejnerske zadatke u ECS-u ili EKS-u; hostovi nisu korisnikova briga.

QuestionText: A workload needs temporary scratch data on storage physically attached to an EC2 host and can tolerate losing that data when the instance stops. Which storage type fits?
Explanation: Instance store daje privremeni lokalni blokovski prostor; podaci ne opstaju nakon zaustavljanja instance.

QuestionText: A team wants point-in-time backups of an Amazon EBS volume that it can use to create new volumes. What should it create?
Explanation: EBS snapshot je kopija volumena u određenom trenutku iz koje se može napraviti novi volumen.

QuestionText: A Linux application needs a shared file system that automatically grows and shrinks as files are added and removed. Which service fits?
Explanation: Amazon EFS je elastičan upravljani fajl sistem kojem može pristupiti više Linux instanci.

QuestionText: A team needs archived objects that are accessed rarely but must be retrieved in milliseconds. Which S3 archival class fits?
Explanation: Glacier Instant Retrieval je arhivska klasa s pristupom u milisekundama; ostale Glacier klase imaju sporije opcije povrata.

QuestionText: A company needs copies of S3 objects in a second AWS Region for compliance. Which S3 capability addresses this?
Explanation: S3 Cross-Region Replication asinhrono kopira objekte između bucket-a u različitim Regijama.

QuestionText: A relational database must fail over automatically to a standby in another Availability Zone when its primary fails. Which Amazon RDS option is designed for this?
Explanation: RDS Multi-AZ održava sinhroni standby i omogućava automatski failover za visoku dostupnost.

QuestionText: A read-heavy relational application needs to spread read queries across additional database instances. Which Amazon RDS feature is appropriate?
Explanation: RDS Read Replicas služe skaliranju čitanja; standby u Multi-AZ postavci primarno služi dostupnosti.

QuestionText: A company has a MongoDB-compatible document application and wants a managed AWS database. Which service best matches?
Explanation: Amazon DocumentDB je upravljana baza kompatibilna s MongoDB API-jem za dokumentne podatke.

QuestionText: A fraud team needs to explore relationships among customers, devices, and transactions as a graph. Which managed database is designed for this?
Explanation: Amazon Neptune je upravljana graf baza za povezane entitete i odnose.

QuestionText: Before migrating a database to a different database engine, a team must convert its schema and stored code. Which AWS tool helps?
Explanation: AWS SCT pretvara postojeću šemu i bazni kod u format ciljnog engine-a; DMS prenosi podatke.

QuestionText: An application in a VPC needs private connectivity to an AWS service without using an internet gateway. Which offering supports this?
Explanation: PrivateLink omogućava privatnu vezu prema podržanim servisima putem VPC endpointa.

QuestionText: A company wants an encrypted tunnel over the internet between its on-premises network and an Amazon VPC. Which service fits?
Explanation: Site-to-Site VPN uspostavlja IPsec tunel između lokalne mreže i VPC-a preko interneta.

QuestionText: Remote employees need a managed VPN connection from their laptops to resources in a VPC. What should the company use?
Explanation: AWS Client VPN je upravljani VPN servis za korisničke uređaje koji pristupaju AWS mrežama.

QuestionText: A company needs a central network hub to connect many VPCs and its on-premises networks. Which service is designed for this?
Explanation: Transit Gateway djeluje kao mrežni hub za povezivanje VPC-ova i lokalnih mreža.

QuestionText: A website routes /images requests to one target group and /api requests to another. Which load balancer supports path-based HTTP routing?
Explanation: Application Load Balancer obrađuje HTTP/HTTPS i može usmjeravati zahtjeve prema URL putanji.

QuestionText: An application needs to distribute TCP connections at very high performance and retain a static IP address. Which load balancer is the best match?
Explanation: Network Load Balancer radi na transportnom sloju, podržava TCP i statične IP adrese.

QuestionText: Private EC2 instances need to download software updates from the internet while remaining unreachable from unsolicited inbound internet traffic. Which component can provide outbound access?
Options: Internet gateway directly on the private subnet
Explanation: NAT gateway omogućava instancama u privatnom subnetu odlazni pristup internetu bez direktnog dolaznog pristupa.

QuestionText: A data analyst wants to run SQL directly against files stored in Amazon S3 without managing servers. Which service fits?
Explanation: Athena omogućava interaktivne SQL upite nad podacima u S3, bez upravljanja serverima.

QuestionText: A team needs a managed ETL service to discover, prepare, and integrate data for analytics. Which service should it choose?
Explanation: AWS Glue je upravljani servis za integraciju podataka i ETL poslove.

QuestionText: A business analyst needs interactive dashboards to visualize AWS and external data. Which AWS service is designed for this?
Explanation: Amazon Quick Sight služi poslovnoj inteligenciji i izradi interaktivnih dashboarda.

QuestionText: A team needs a managed platform to run Apache Spark and Hadoop big-data jobs. Which service fits?
Explanation: Amazon EMR upravlja klasterima i frameworkovima kao što su Spark i Hadoop.

QuestionText: A team needs a managed service to index application logs for search and analysis. Which option fits?
Explanation: OpenSearch Service pruža upravljano pretraživanje i analitiku nad indeksiranim podacima.

QuestionText: A data science team wants a managed environment to build, train, and deploy machine-learning models. Which service should it use?
Explanation: SageMaker AI objedinjuje razvoj, treniranje i implementaciju ML modela.

QuestionText: A retail app needs to identify objects and scenes in uploaded product photos. Which AI service is most suitable?
Explanation: Rekognition analizira slike i video te prepoznaje objekte i scene.

QuestionText: A finance team wants to extract printed text and key-value fields from scanned invoices. Which service best fits?
Explanation: Textract izvlači tekst, obrasce i tabele iz skeniranih dokumenata.

QuestionText: A company wants to detect sentiment and key phrases in customer reviews. Which service should it use?
Explanation: Comprehend koristi NLP za analizu sentimenta i ključnih fraza u tekstu.

QuestionText: A call center wants searchable text transcripts of recorded customer calls. Which service is designed for this?
Explanation: Transcribe pretvara govor u tekst, uključujući snimljeni audio.

QuestionText: A multilingual support portal needs automatic translation of written replies. Which service should it use?
Explanation: Amazon Translate automatski prevodi pisani tekst između jezika; Polly i Transcribe rade s govorom.

QuestionText: An accessibility feature must read text aloud in a natural-sounding voice. Which service provides this?
Explanation: Amazon Polly pretvara pisani tekst u govorni audio, uključujući glasove pogodne za čitanje sadržaja naglas.

QuestionText: A company needs a conversational chatbot that understands user intent and handles voice or text requests. Which service fits?
Explanation: Lex gradi razgovorne interfejse za tekst i govor uz prepoznavanje namjere korisnika.

QuestionText: An order event must notify several teams immediately and also remain available for a worker to process later. Which TWO services work together for this pattern? (Choose 2.)
Explanation: SNS šalje poruku više pretplatnika; pretplaćeni SQS red trajno je čuva dok je radnik ne preuzme.

QuestionText: An application must send high-volume transactional emails, such as receipts and password-reset messages. Which service is intended for this?
Explanation: Amazon SES je upravljani servis za slanje i primanje e-pošte aplikacija.

QuestionText: A business wants a cloud contact center for inbound customer calls without building its own telephony platform. Which service fits?
Explanation: Amazon Connect je upravljani kontakt-centar za korisničku komunikaciju.

QuestionText: A developer needs to trace a request across several application components to identify where latency occurs. Which service helps?
Explanation: AWS X-Ray prikuplja tragove zahtjeva radi analize ponašanja i latencije distribuirane aplikacije.

QuestionText: Which TWO AWS developer tools cover source-code builds and orchestration of release stages? (Choose 2.)
Explanation: CodeBuild automatizuje gradnju i testiranje koda; CodePipeline orkestrira faze isporuke.

QuestionText: A company wants to stream a desktop application to users through a browser without giving them a full persistent virtual desktop. Which service fits?
Explanation: Amazon WorkSpaces Applications, ranije AppStream 2.0, streamuje aplikacije u browser; Amazon WorkSpaces pruža upravljane virtuelne desktopove.

QuestionText: Which TWO AWS services respectively let users access a managed virtual desktop and a secure browser environment? (Choose 2.)
Explanation: WorkSpaces daje virtuelni desktop, dok WorkSpaces Secure Browser omogućava siguran pristup web sadržaju kroz upravljani browser.

QuestionText: An Amazon Linux EC2 On-Demand instance runs for 3 minutes and 20 seconds. Which billing granularity generally applies?
Options: No charge until one hour has passed
Always rounded to one full day
Always rounded to one full month
Explanation: Podržane EC2 Linux instance naplaćuju se po sekundi uz najmanje 60 sekundi korištenja.

QuestionText: Which TWO dimensions commonly affect the cost of Amazon S3 storage? (Choose 2.)
Options: Number of IAM users in the account
Explanation: S3 cijena zavisi od količine pohranjenih podataka i izabrane klase, uz moguće troškove zahtjeva i prenosa.

QuestionText: A team invokes a Lambda function twice as often and doubles its execution duration. Which pricing idea explains the likely increase?
Options: Lambda charges can depend on request count and compute duration
The number of Availability Zones alone determines the charge
Only stored code size is billable
Lambda always has one fixed monthly fee
Explanation: Lambda naplata uključuje broj zahtjeva i trajanje izvršavanja, uz zavisnost od dodijeljene memorije.

QuestionText: A finance team sees a low S3 storage rate but many object downloads. Which extra cost dimension should it examine?
Options: Retrieval or request charges for the selected class
Explanation: S3 klase imaju različite cijene zahtjeva i povrata podataka, pa sama cijena po GB nije ukupni trošak.

QuestionText: Which TWO examples are typical variable AWS cost drivers? (Choose 2.)
Options: Age of the AWS account alone
Number of engineers who read public documentation
Number of AWS Regions announced globally
Explanation: AWS cijena često prati korištenje računalnog kapaciteta i prijenos podataka prema cjeniku usluge.

QuestionText: A team wants AWS to recommend an appropriate Savings Plans commitment using its historical compute usage. Where can it find these recommendations?
Explanation: Cost Explorer prikazuje preporuke za Savings Plans na osnovu ranijeg korištenja.

QuestionText: A company can commit to a specific EC2 instance family in one Region and wants a larger discount than a more flexible Compute Savings Plan. Which option should it compare?
Explanation: EC2 Instance Savings Plans vežu popust za porodicu instanci i Regiju, pa su manje fleksibilni od Compute Savings Plans.

QuestionText: A company already owns a Savings Plan. How is the discount generally applied to matching eligible usage?
Options: Only after opening a Support case
Only after exporting a PDF invoice
Only after creating an S3 bucket
Explanation: AWS obračun automatski primjenjuje Savings Plans povoljniju stopu na odgovarajuće korištenje.

QuestionText: A company buys a Savings Plan but wants to avoid any initial payment. Which payment choice should it review?
Explanation: Savings Plans imaju No Upfront, Partial Upfront i All Upfront opcije plaćanja; No Upfront nema početnu uplatu.

QuestionText: Which THREE payment options can be offered for Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances? (Choose 3.)
Explanation: EC2 Reserved Instances nude No Upfront, Partial Upfront i All Upfront modele plaćanja.

QuestionText: A business buys a Reserved Instance but stops using matching capacity halfway through its term. Which statement is correct?
Options: The RI commitment continues to incur its agreed charges
The RI turns into a Free Tier credit
Explanation: Reserved Instance je obaveza na rok; neiskorištenost sama po sebi ne ukida trošak obaveze.

QuestionText: An EBS-backed EC2 instance is stopped. Which charge may continue while its compute charge stops?
Explanation: Zaustavljena EC2 instanca ne naplaćuje računalno korištenje, ali pohrana prikačenih EBS volumena i dalje se naplaćuje.

QuestionText: A planner has built an AWS Pricing Calculator estimate and wants colleagues to review the same assumptions. What can the planner generate?
Explanation: Pricing Calculator može generisati javni link za dijeljenje procjene s kolegama.

QuestionText: Why can a Pricing Calculator estimate differ from the final monthly invoice?
Options: Actual usage and data transfer may differ from entered assumptions
Estimates include unlimited usage by default
Explanation: Kalkulator daje procjenu na osnovu pretpostavki; stvarni račun prati realnu potrošnju i cijene.

QuestionText: A multi-account organization wants a chart showing which member account caused last month’s cost increase. Which Cost Explorer grouping should it use?
Explanation: Cost Explorer može grupisati troškove po povezanom članskom nalogu organizacije.

QuestionText: Which statement about AWS Cost Explorer forecasts is most accurate?
Options: They are estimates based on observed spending patterns
They include costs of resources never configured
Explanation: Cost Explorer prognozira buduću potrošnju iz istorijskih podataka; procjena nije garantovani račun.

QuestionText: After creating an AWS Cost and Usage Report, where does AWS deliver the report files?
Options: An Amazon S3 bucket specified by the customer
Explanation: AWS isporučuje Cost and Usage Report u S3 bucket koji korisnik navede.

QuestionText: A team wants an alert when EC2 usage hours exceed a target, even if the dollar cost varies. Which budget type fits?
Explanation: AWS Budgets podržava budžet zasnovan na količini korištenja, odvojeno od novčanog troška.

QuestionText: Which TWO measurements can AWS Budgets monitor for Savings Plans? (Choose 2.)
Options: Number of AWS documentation pages viewed
Explanation: AWS Budgets ima budžete za iskorištenost i pokrivenost Savings Plans obavezama.

QuestionText: A team wants to know whether its Reserved Instances sit unused. Which budget category should it inspect?
Explanation: Reservation utilization prati koliko se kupljenih rezervacija stvarno koristi.

QuestionText: A cost anomaly monitor detects an unusual charge. Which TWO notification destinations does AWS Cost Anomaly Detection support? (Choose 2.)
Explanation: Cost Anomaly Detection može dostaviti upozorenje e-poštom ili preko SNS teme.

QuestionText: Which statement describes a practical limit of AWS Cost Anomaly Detection?
Options: It monitors CPU health instead of spending
It may detect anomalies after billing data becomes available rather than instantly
It prevents all charges before they occur
Explanation: Detekcija se oslanja na obrađene podatke o troškovima, pa nije trenutna blokada potrošnje.

QuestionText: A cost report must break down usage by a custom Project tag. What must be done after tagging supported resources?
Options: Activate that user-defined tag for cost allocation
Create an IAM root user for each project
Move every resource to a new Region
Explanation: Korisnički tagovi moraju biti aktivirani u Billing and Cost Management da bi se pojavili u izvještajima.

QuestionText: A company wants to group several accounts and services under business labels such as Production and Research in cost reports. Which feature is intended for rule-based grouping?
Explanation: Cost Categories grupišu troškove prema pravilima nad dimenzijama kao što su nalozi, servisi i tagovi.

QuestionText: Which account in an AWS Organization is responsible for paying the consolidated charges of member accounts?
Explanation: U konsolidiranom obračunu management account plaća troškove članica organizacije.

QuestionText: Which benefit can result when eligible usage from accounts in an AWS Organization is combined?
Options: Volume pricing tiers may be reached sooner
Each account receives unlimited free EC2
Explanation: Konsolidirani obračun agregira korištenje naloga pa može donijeti količinske popuste.

QuestionText: A finance team wants to allocate every charge in a department’s AWS account, including resources that cannot be tagged individually. Which cost-allocation approach fits?
Options: Open a support case for each invoice
Use an SCP to label every charge
Activate an AWS Organizations account tag for cost allocation
Explanation: Aktivirani tag na AWS nalogu može dodijeliti troškove cijelog naloga poslovnoj jedinici, uključujući netagabilne stavke.

QuestionText: Can service control policies be used when an AWS Organization has only consolidated billing features enabled?
Options: Yes; they are available in billing-only mode
No; all features must be enabled
Only if there is one member account
Explanation: AWS dokumentacija navodi da SCP zahtijeva Organizations all-features način rada.

QuestionText: A new customer on the AWS Free account plan joins an AWS Organization. What happens to the account plan?
Options: It automatically upgrades to the Paid account plan
It loses access to the Billing console
Explanation: AWS navodi da ulazak u Organizations automatski prebacuje Free nalog na Paid plan.

QuestionText: A new customer on the AWS Free account plan wants to buy an EC2 Reserved Instance. What must it do first?
Options: Upgrade to the Paid account plan
Explanation: Kupovina Reserved Instances nije dostupna na Free planu; potrebno je preći na Paid plan.

QuestionText: An account needs a higher AWS service quota but has only Basic Support. Which statement is correct?
Options: The account must buy Dedicated Hosts first
A designated TAM is required for every quota increase
Basic Support includes assistance with service quota increase requests
Explanation: AWS navodi pomoć za povećanje kvota servisa među mogućnostima Basic Support plana.

QuestionText: A production team needs AWS assistance with common third-party software components running on EC2. Which current support plan first includes third-party software support?
Explanation: Business Support+ uključuje podršku za popularne komponente softvera trećih strana na AWS-u.

QuestionText: A company wants strategic business reviews with AWS experts as part of its support relationship. Which current support plan includes this benefit?
Explanation: AWS Enterprise Support uključuje strateške poslovne preglede s AWS stručnjacima.

QuestionText: Which current AWS Support offering includes a designated Domain Specialist Engineer in addition to a TAM for specific workloads?
Explanation: Unified Operations uključuje TAM-a i Domain Specialist Engineer-a za konkretne aplikacije i potrebe.

QuestionText: Which TWO capabilities are included with AWS Business Support+? (Choose 2.)
Options: A designated TAM for every account
Automatic payment of all AWS invoices
Explanation: Business Support+ uključuje neprekidan kontakt s inženjerima i Support API; TAM dolazi uz Enterprise.

QuestionText: A business-critical production system is down. Which current plan first lists human engagement in under 30 minutes for this severity?
Explanation: Business Support+ navodi angažman čovjeka za business-critical system down za manje od 30 minuta.

QuestionText: A company wants AWS Security Incident Response included with its support plan at no additional service charge. Which is the minimum current plan that provides it?
Explanation: AWS Enterprise Support uključuje AWS Security Incident Response bez dodatne naknade za taj servis.

QuestionText: A team wants a recommendation about idle or underused AWS resources that might waste money. Which AWS tool provides such checks?
Explanation: Trusted Advisor uključuje provjere optimizacije troškova, poput resursa koji se nedovoljno koriste.

QuestionText: A support engineer wants to programmatically retrieve AWS events affecting the account’s own resources. Which interface is relevant?
Explanation: AWS Health API izlaže događaje vezane za konkretan nalog i njegove resurse.

QuestionText: An engineer wants to ask an AWS technical question in a public expert community without opening a paid support case. Which resource fits?
Explanation: AWS re:Post je zajednica za tehnička pitanja i odgovore o AWS-u.

QuestionText: A migration team seeks official AWS implementation patterns and step-by-step migration guidance. Which resource is most relevant?
Explanation: AWS Prescriptive Guidance objavljuje obrasce i smjernice za migraciju i modernizaciju.

QuestionText: A company wants official service API references and setup instructions. Where should it look first?
Explanation: AWS Documentation je zvanični izvor korisničkih i API vodiča za AWS servise.

QuestionText: A customer seeks an AWS-recognized system integrator to help implement its migration. Which program helps find such partners?
Explanation: AWS Partner Network povezuje klijente s kvalifikovanim partnerima, uključujući sistemske integratore.

QuestionText: A buyer must inspect active and expired third-party software agreements already purchased through AWS Marketplace. Where should it go?
Explanation: Marketplace Manage subscriptions prikazuje aktivne i neaktivne pretplate te detalje njihovih ugovora.

QuestionText: An organization needs hands-on consulting from AWS experts for a major cloud transformation project. Which AWS offering is appropriate?
Explanation: AWS Professional Services pruža stručni angažman za planiranje i realizaciju cloud projekata.

QuestionText: A developer wants to find official AWS technical articles that answer common customer support questions. Which resource category fits?
Explanation: Knowledge Center na re:Postu sadrži službene AWS članke o čestim tehničkim pitanjima.

QuestionText: A user wants to open an AWS Support case and later review the case correspondence. Which AWS interface provides this?
Explanation: Support Center omogućava otvaranje slučaja podrške i pregled detalja i komunikacije.

QuestionText: A team needs a prebuilt cost dashboard combining budgets, spending trends, and reservation coverage. Which AWS area provides this?
Options: AWS Billing and Cost Management Dashboards
Explanation: Billing and Cost Management Dashboards objedinjuju Cost Explorer, Budgets i mjere pokrivenosti obaveza.

QuestionText: A company requires separate AWS accounts per department yet wants centrally governed billing. Which TWO AWS Organizations concepts support this? (Choose 2.)
Options: A single IAM user used across all accounts
One shared root password for everyone
One EC2 instance for every department
Explanation: Management account upravlja organizacijom i plaća konsolidirani račun, a članice ostaju odvojeni AWS nalozi.
